methodology.market: Player to hit a triple — Yes
methodology.stake: 1 unit per bet; American-odds profit on wins and -1 unit on losses
methodology.outcomes: Official MLB game logs matched to the exact gamePk; no plate appearance is void
methodology.archive_best_benchmark: Best archived price across 08:17, 11:17, and 17:17, once per player/slate. This is a hindsight price benchmark, not a fixed-time strategy.
methodology.checkpoint_strategy: Each fixed checkpoint is reported separately so 08:17, 11:17, and 17:17 can be judged as executable timing rules.
methodology.completed_slate_policy: Profit reports include a slate only after every resolved priced row on that date has a final result; partial slates are excluded wholesale.
methodology.form_score: 0.50*(triple games L5/5) + 0.30*(triple games L7/7) + 0.20*(triple games L15/15), using only games before the slate
methodology.edge_gate: At least 40 settled bets, 3 wins, 5 slates, and positive net units
methodology.warning: Observed historical segments are provisional and multiple comparisons can produce false positives. They are not guarantees or fair-value estimates.
